scenarios.name: skipping-the-draw-protects-from-non-flying-attackers
scenarios.why: Oracle: if you would draw a card during your draw step, instead you may skip that draw; if you do, until your next turn you can't be attacked except by creatures with flying and/or islandwalk. p0 controls Island Sanctuary and skips the draw in p0's own draw step; on p1's turn p1's Grizzly Bears may not attack p0, while Wind Drake (flying) may.
